law.catch_line: Changes in form of ownership, make, name
law.text: Any change in the form of ownership or the addition or deletion of a partner shall require a new application, license, and fee. Any addition or deletion of a franchise or change in the name of a dealer shall require immediate notification to the Department and the Board, and the Board shall endorse the change on the license without a fee. The change of an officer or director of a corporation shall be made at the time of license renewal.
